name: dcmtk-32520a28-blind16
instr:
# DCMTK character set conversion gone wrong, without a test suite

The repository has received 16 separate undocumented edits.

Software built on this toolkit converts text between character encodings, and it now gets
that wrong in many places. Nothing about the encodings changed and nothing about the
calling code changed; the same conversions that used to come back right now come back
wrong, and in several places a conversion that used to run is refused outright.

Asking which encodings it is able to convert between comes back empty, and a conversion
asked for under a name that is listed in the tables shipped with the toolkit is refused as
though that name were unknown. Asking for a converter between two names for which no
conversion can be built reports success instead, handing back what looks like a working
result with no error raised to the caller. Asking for a converter between a pair of
encodings whose characters line up one for one, so that no lookup table is wanted at all,
fails before any text is seen, and that failure carries into nearly every conversion among
single-byte encodings and into the handling of text in medical imaging records. Many other
pairs of encodings also refuse to open, and conversions into plain ASCII from ISO 8859 text
and from single-byte Japanese text come back wrong or never run. Asking for a converter
from UTF-8 into the single-byte ISO 8859 encodings fails the moment that converter is
